metadata.title: Research opportunities
metadata.description: Explore research collaboration, postgraduate and visiting opportunities with the MSEI Lab.

html:
We welcome enquiries from prospective PhD students, project students, visiting researchers and research collaborators who are interested in adaptive physical intelligence and dexterous manipulation across scales.

Research interests

  • Tactile sensing and physical-state inference: sensor design, multimodal perception and microscopy-based estimation.
  • Robot learning: data-efficient skill acquisition, imitation learning, multimodal policies and transfer between tasks or sensors.
  • Shared autonomy: adaptive assistance, haptic interaction and precise manipulation with people in the loop.
  • Embodiment and actuation: tactile materials and grippers, optical and magnetic actuation, and small-scale robotic systems.

Explore our research themes and experimental platforms and publications to identify a potential fit.

Discuss a project

Please email d.zhang17@imperial.ac.uk with a concise introduction and:

  • Your CV, including relevant education, research and publications;
  • A short statement explaining the research question you would like to pursue and how it connects to the lab;
  • Links to relevant work, such as a project report, paper, code repository or portfolio;
  • Your proposed start period, intended programme or visit, and any funding route you are considering.

Relevant backgrounds include bioengineering, robotics, computer science, electrical or mechanical engineering, mathematics and related disciplines.

Please contact Dandan to discuss project fit, supervision availability, eligibility and funding routes before making a formal application. Specific funded openings, deadlines and application requirements will be listed when confirmed.
